name: doki-runtime
description: DOKI side-channel runtime for FalsifyMe: read-only observation, deterministic history/Q-learning, model selection and SQLite persistence. DOKI carries NO own release version — the single version source of this repo is the root package.json (FalsifyMe release); semantic contract versions live in doki/src/contracts.mjs (RUNTIME_VERSION) and the *-RULE_VERSION constants.
